concept.title: Assigning tasks to a milestone
concept.shortdesc: A milestone can own tasks: the work that has to be finished to reach it. Assign them from either side:

ul.li: In a task's panel, choose its Milestone.
In a milestone's panel, under Tasks, choose Assign a task. The list there shows each of the milestone's tasks with its progress, and the cross takes a task off the milestone.

conbody.p: A task belongs to one milestone at a time, which may be a release's. Assigning a task that has sub-tasks brings them with it: each sub-task counts toward the milestone unless it is given a milestone of its own. The milestone counts the tasks that have no sub-tasks, so a task and its sub-tasks are not counted twice.

A milestone with tasks measures Milestone tasks done, the share of those tasks in Done, as one of its criteria, with a target of 100%. You do not have to add it: it is there as soon as the milestone has a task, so finishing the tasks is part of the milestone's percentage alongside its other criteria. To ask for less than all of them, add the criterion yourself and set its target. A milestone whose only criterion is its tasks is met when they are all done.
Plan tasks done is a different measure: it counts every task of the plan due by the milestone's date, assigned or not.
